visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with high-contrast text overlays reading 'EXPO 2025' over a blurred Japanese train station. Clear shots of the Osaka Metro station interior follow, showing commuters in casual clothing and business attire walking through ticket gates and spacious hallways. Signage for the Chuo Line and Cosmosquare is visible. The lighting is bright, even, and artificial, typical of a modern transportation hub. (2) The scene shifts to the Expo 2025 construction site and harbor area. A massive crowd of people, including families and students, is shown traversing a curved wooden walkway through a green wetland area under a clear, bright sky. Large red and white industrial cranes stand in the background near the water. At night, a dramatic water fountain performance is shown with bright blue and purple spotlights illuminating jets of water synchronized with fireworks. (3) Transitions occur to urban scenes in Nagoya and Toyama. The visuals feature fast-paced shots of train platforms, street signs, and traditional Japanese restaurant exteriors with red lanterns. Crowds of people are seen entering subway stations. The camera captures close-ups of vending machine products, specifically green tea bottles. The lighting varies from natural daylight to vibrant neon night lights. (4) Nature segments follow, showcasing the Kurobe Dam and surrounding mountains with colorful autumn foliage. A cable car is seen ascending a steep slope, and the camera provides panoramic views of a turquoise alpine lake. People are shown wearing hiking gear and backpacks, observing the scenery from a mountain-top viewing deck. The weather is partly cloudy with soft, natural lighting. (5) The final phase highlights Tokyo's urban landscape. Iconic structures like Tokyo Tower are shown at dusk, followed by the colorful digital art installations of teamLab Borderless. The Ginza and Shinjuku districts are featured with dense neon advertisements and streams of car headlights. The visual rhythm is rapid, using fast cuts to transition between diverse locations.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-energy electronic pop music bed featuring a female vocalist singing melodic phrases over a syncopated 4/4 drum beat at 124 BPM. Bright synthesizer chords provide the harmonic foundation. Faint 'whoosh' sound effects are inserted at every major visual cut. (2) During the train station scenes, subtle ambient station chatter and the sound of electronic ticket gate chimes ('ding') are mixed into the background. The music remains dominant but creates space for these environmental cues. The vocal delivery is upbeat and optimistic. (3) In the nature and transportation segments, the audio includes mechanical sounds of a cable car and the brief sound of a train horn, both layered with the continuous BGM. A saxophone and trumpet riff appear in the music track during the night performance scenes, matching the visual of the live musicians. (4) The final section maintains the consistent tempo but features more intense percussive elements as the visuals transition into neon-lit night street scenes. The audio finishes with a sharp rhythmic cutoff, leaving a brief echo of the synthesizers.
